personality_one_liner: An ultra-minimalist, monochrome task-oriented utility that strips away visual noise to focus strictly on job application velocity and tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around list items. No extra containers. Padding aligns strictly to the grid.

dont's: Never use blur, brutalist personality mandates solid monochrome surfaces.

screens.name: Home (Log Pengiriman)
screens.purpose: A task-oriented list of job applications sent.

states.empty: Subtle wireframe illustration of a mailbox + 'Belum ada lamaran dikirim'.
states.error: Text 'Gagal memuat data' + Retry action outline button.

screens.layout: App Bar: Left aligned title 'Lamaran' 20pt bold, right aligned Sync icon. Main content: vertical list of cards. Card Layout: Flex row. Left column flex:1 contains Position (14pt Bold), Company (12pt), Email (11pt Gray), and a status badge beneath. Right column: Large circular checkbox. Divider between rows. Bottom-right: Black circular FAB with '+' icon.

screens.name: Form Tambah Lamaran (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Quick entry form for new applications.

states.error: Inline text underneath fields in error color.

screens.layout: No top header, simple drag handle. Fields stacked vertically with thin bottom border (underlined) and no bounding box. Focus state turns border black (#18181B). PDF selection: horizontal scroll of pill chips, drag-to-reorder if possible. Bottom action: sticky capsule button 'Simpan Ke Sheet' in black.

screens.name: Referensi Berkas
screens.purpose: Repository of PDF resume and portfolio attachments.
screens.layout: Header 'Gudang Referensi Berkas' and subheader. List of files separated by thin 1px dividers. At the bottom, a 'Synchronize Drive' outline button with an inline spinner state.

screens.name: Inbox HRD
screens.purpose: Track incoming responses with fast visual categorization.
screens.layout: List layout: Each row features a colored category dot on the left. Company (bold), subject, date. On tap -> Detail View: Company header (18pt bold), sender (gray), full subject. A standout green highlight box (bg: success, text: onSuccess) extracts key info like interview time. A 'Buka di Gmail' outline button below. Sticky bottom container with text input and send arrow for follow-ups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the black/white/zinc palette + dictated status colors. No purple/blue default accents. Selection color is Black (#18181B).
Tab bar is monochrome: selected item is black (#18181B), unselected is gray (#71717A).
For the Home screen 'circular checkbox', use a custom pressable with radius `pill` and 1px border. When checked, fill with black and white checkmark.
Form inputs must use a single bottom border (`borderBottomWidth: 1`) and no other borders or background container. Focus state changes border color to `borderStrong`.
Badges use a very light background with medium-dark text for contrast (e.g., Terkirim = bg #DCFCE7, text #15803D).
In the HRD Inbox detail view, implement the sticky bottom input using KeyboardAvoidingView with fixed padding, so it stays directly above the keyboard.
